name: typephp
one_liner: Compiles PHP code into a fast native program instead of running it the normal, slower way.
buyer: A PHP shop running a performance-sensitive service (a high-traffic API) that wants speed without rewriting in another language.
business_use_cases: A PHP SaaS company compiles its hottest API endpoints to native binaries to cut server costs.
A vendor selling on-premise software written in PHP ships a compiled native binary instead of exposing source code.

money_ideas.idea: Offer a paid 'PHP performance audit and compile' consulting service for legacy PHP shops trying to cut hosting bills.

steal_this: Pick a slow PHP shop's busiest endpoint, compile it with this, benchmark the savings, and pitch it as a paid performance-audit case study.
